_note: 學習路徑內容建置第13批 #6／6：介系詞＋關係代名詞（eng.t_adv.relcl.prep-plus-relative，學測級／高階）。正式英語中介系詞可移到關係子句最前面、放在關係代名詞前：the house in which I live、the person to whom I spoke。介系詞前移時指人只能用 whom、指物只能用 which，不能用 who 或 that。日常口語常把介系詞留句尾、用 who/that 或省略。誘答以『prep 後不可用 that／不可用 who／which 限物 whom 限人／口語介系詞後移』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ppr_）。

units.title_zh: 介系詞＋關係代名詞（the person to whom…）
units.can_do: 我能用『介系詞＋關係代名詞』的正式結構（the house in which I live、the person to whom I spoke），知道介系詞移到關係代名詞前面時只能用 whom（指人）或 which（指物），不能用 who 或 that，也知道口語常把介系詞留句尾。
units.situation_group: 關係子句 Preposition + relative pronoun
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In formal English the preposition can move to the front of a relative clause, directly before the relative pronoun: 'the house in which I live', 'the person to whom I spoke.'
claims.verification_ref: 正式英語介系詞可前移到關係代名詞前；the house in which I live；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the preposition comes before the relative pronoun, we must use 'whom' (for people) or 'which' (for things); we cannot use 'who' or 'that': 'the man with whom I work' (not 'with who', not 'with that').
claims.verification_ref: 介系詞前置時指人用 whom、指物用 which；不可用 who/that；the man with whom I work；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'That' can never follow a preposition, and 'who' cannot follow a preposition either; only 'whom' and 'which' can: 'the topic about which we talked' (not 'about that', not 'about who').
claims.verification_ref: 介系詞後不可接 that、不可接 who；只能 whom/which；the topic about which we talked；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In everyday English we usually keep the preposition at the end and use 'who/that' or leave the pronoun out, with the same meaning: 'the person I spoke to' = 'the person to whom I spoke' (the second is more formal).
claims.verification_ref: 口語介系詞留句尾用 who/that 或省略；the person I spoke to＝the person to whom I spoke；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: In more formal English, the preposition can move to the front of the relative clause, right before the relative pronoun: the house in which I live, the person to whom I spoke.
teach.zh_hint: 在比較正式的英語裡，介系詞可以移到關係子句的最前面，放在關係代名詞前面：the house in which I live（我住的那間房子）、the person to whom I spoke（我說話的那個人）。

teach.body: This is the house in which I live.
teach.zh_hint: 這是我住的房子。介系詞 in 放在 which 前面。

teach.body: The key point: when the preposition comes before the relative pronoun, we use 'whom' for people and 'which' for things. We cannot use 'who', and we cannot use 'that'.
teach.zh_hint: 重點：介系詞放在關係代名詞『前面』時，指人只能用 whom、指物只能用 which，不能用 who，也不能用 that。

teach.body: She is the person to whom I spoke.
teach.zh_hint: 她是我說過話的那個人。指人、介系詞前用 whom。

teach.body: In everyday speech we usually leave the preposition at the end and use 'who' or 'that', or drop the relative pronoun altogether: the person I spoke to. It means the same as 'the person to whom I spoke'; the second one is just more formal.
teach.zh_hint: 日常口語通常把介系詞留在句尾，用 who／that 或直接省略關係代名詞：the person I spoke to。意思和 the person to whom I spoke 一樣，只是後者比較正式。

teach.body: He is the man with whom I work.
teach.zh_hint: 他是和我一起工作的人。指人、介系詞 with 前用 whom。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係代名詞：She is the teacher to ____ I owe a lot.（我很感激的老師）

distractor_rationales.who: 介系詞 to 後面不能用 who；指人要用 whom。
distractor_rationales.that: 介系詞後面絕對不能用 that。
distractor_rationales.which: which 指物；這裡指人（teacher），要用 whom。

practice.feedback: 介系詞前、指人用 whom：the teacher to whom I owe a lot。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係代名詞：This is the tool with ____ we fixed the car.（我們用來修車的工具）

distractor_rationales.that: 介系詞 with 後面不能用 that。
distractor_rationales.whom: whom 指人；這裡指物（tool），要用 which。
distractor_rationales.who: who 指人、且介系詞後不能用 who；指物用 which。

practice.feedback: 介系詞前、指物用 which：the tool with which we fixed the car。

practice.answer: The club to which he belongs is famous.
options: The club to which he belongs is famous.
The club to that he belongs is famous.
The club to who he belongs is famous.
The club which he belongs is famous.

介系詞 to 後面不能用 that。
介系詞後不能用 who；且 club 指物要用 which。
belong 要搭配 to（belong to）；這裡少了介系詞 to。

practice.feedback: 介系詞前、指物用 which：the club to which he belongs。

practice.stem: 'the person to whom I wrote' 最口語／非正式的說法是？
options: the person to who I wrote
the person which I wrote to
the person to that I wrote

distractor_rationales.the person to who I wrote: 介系詞 to 後面不能用 who；此說法錯誤，不是口語版。
distractor_rationales.the person which I wrote to: which 指物；指人要用 who/that 或省略。

practice.feedback: 口語把介系詞留句尾、常省略關代：the person I wrote to。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係代名詞：That's the reason for ____ he left.（他離開的原因）

distractor_rationales.that: 介系詞 for 後面不能用 that。
distractor_rationales.who: who 指人、且介系詞後不能用；reason 是物，要用 which。
distractor_rationales.whom: whom 指人；reason 是物，要用 which。

practice.feedback: 介系詞前、指物（reason）用 which：the reason for which he left。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: This is the book in which I found the answer.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：in which 有沒有寫對、I found the answer 有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。介系詞與 which/whom 連貫、句尾下收。

lines.text: That is the team with which I work.
lines.intonation: That is the team 起、with which I work 句尾下收

lines.text: This is the topic about which we talked.
lines.intonation: This is the topic 起、about which we talked 句尾下收
